title: Compact tier-aware onboarding modal walkthrough for model recommendations and deprecation banners
creator: Anya Patel
description: Design a compact, mobile-first onboarding modal and quickstart screenshot set that surfaces tier-aware model recommendations, clearly communicates new model launches, and highlights imminent deprecations with contextual pricing callouts. Deliver final PNG/JPEG assets for release notes, docs, and the Console quickstart flow. This ticket covers art direction, responsive screenshots, annotated handoff specs, and a small run of localized variants.
background: Product wants a low-friction onboarding experience for new users and teams that makes model selection easy while making deprecation risk explicit. Current catalog quickstart is desktop-heavy and doesn't call out pricing tiers by default; we need a compact modal that fits inside the existing Console Quickstart path and a set of release-note-ready screenshots to accompany the February catalog update.
design_goals: Surface recommended model based on selected cost/latency preference (tier-aware badge)
Clearly mark new models and flagged-for-deprecation models in the same visual language
Keep modal usable on 320px width and in the Console chrome without requiring extra vertical space
Provide annotated assets for release notes and docs with copy variants for 'new' vs 'deprecated' states
Meet AA contrast for badges and ensure screen-reader label strings are available
acceptance_criteria: Modal fits inside 320x568 viewport without horizontal scroll
Badge system shows 'Recommended (Tier: Low Cost)' and 'New'/'Deprecated' states with accessible contrast
Release screenshots include a 16:9 hero and a compact modal crop for notes page
Design tokens and spacing documented in Figma handoff file
Design reviewed and signed off by PM (Janelle Kim) and Eng lead (Ravi Singh)
All assets exported at 2x and 1x and uploaded to Drive link in attachments
tasks: Mock new/deprecation states and iterate based on PM feedback
Create annotated handoff with spacing and token names
Export assets, produce light + dark variants
Prepare localization copy table and request translations
Add brief QA checklist for screenshots and run through Console flow
Upload final assets to release Drive folder and add links to PR

design_notes: Use a single-row badge system: small pill for 'Recommended (Tier)' with color mapped to tier (green=low cost, amber=balanced, indigo=high perf). 'New' uses an outline star icon; 'Deprecated' uses a subtle red ribbon at top-right with 'deprecated date' hover state. For mobile, move pricing callout to an expandable row to keep initial modal height compact. Avoid gradients on badges to maintain production screenshots consistent across themes.
review_feedback: PM Janelle: 'Favor short microcopy; keep the pricing callout to 1 line with a link to the pricing explainer.'
Eng Ravi: 'Reserve vertical space for runtime banners; modal should not cause CLS when banners appear.'
Accessibility reviewer Priya: 'Contrast check — red ribbon at 15% opacity fails AA. Increase opacity and add text outline.'
qa_notes: QA should validate: screenshot crops match exported specs, badges render correctly across light/dark themes, modal does not overlap runtime banners on tablet, and localized strings fit without truncation for Spanish and French. Attach final verified screenshots to this ticket and update docs PR.
